item.title: GLM 5.2 beats Claude in our benchmarks
item.description:

item.title: Librepods: AirPods liberated
item.description:
📝 LibrePods allows you to use AirPods features that are exclusive to Apple devices. Since this needs deeper integration with audio on Android, it will most likely need root. Android also shows a popup when the other device takes over.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/librepods-org/librepods

item.title: Professor denounces mass AI fraud on an exam at Brown
item.description:
📝 At that point, he received a note acknowledging that what had happened in his classroom was “a wake-up call. “Some answers contained unusual passages that coincided with results obtained after running the questions through ChatGPT,” he says. Serrano did not void the midterm exam, but warned students that the final one, which counted for 50% of the final grade, would be held in-person.

item.title: Do LLMs pass the mirror test?
item.description:
📝 Horowitz's fix was simple and, in retrospect, obvious: present dogs with their own scent, then present them with their own scent modified — laced with aniseed oil. So what does this have to do with LLMs. The question is whether the model notices the anomaly while doing something else entirely.
🔗 Read more: https://blog.pascalschuster.de/article/do-llms-pass-the-mirror-test
